meta.title: Salon Management Software | POS, Booking, CRM & WhatsApp | Digithack
meta.description: Complete salon management software for billing, booking, membership, loyalty points and WhatsApp integration. Built for modern salons and spas.

hero.headline: Smart Salon Management Software
hero.subLine: All-in-one cloud system to manage appointments, billing, staff, memberships and customer engagement for modern salons.

blocks.title: Complete Salon & Spa Management
blocks.content: Our salon software helps you manage appointments, billing, staff and customer relationships from one easy dashboard. Designed for salons, spas and beauty studios to run daily operations smoothly and improve client experience.

blocks.title: Cloud Based System
blocks.content: Full cloud setup allows you to access your salon data from anywhere. Manage appointments, billing and reports in real time from desktop, tablet or mobile.

items.title: Service & Product Billing
items.description: Fast POS for salon services as well as retail products like cosmetics and hair care items.

items.title: Stock Management
items.description: Track product stock, auto-update inventory after each sale and get low stock alerts.

blocks.title: Appointments & Booking
blocks.content: Manage advance bookings, walk-ins and staff schedules with a clear calendar view. Avoid double bookings and keep your salon organized.

blocks.title: Customer Engagement
items: Loyalty points system for repeat visits

items.title: WhatsApp Integration
items.description: Send appointment reminders, bills and offers directly to customers via WhatsApp.

items.title: Service Reminders
items.description: Automatic reminders for next visits to improve customer retention.

blocks.content: Digithack salon management software is simple, secure and customizable for your workflow. Whether you run a single salon or multiple branches, manage everything from one powerful system and deliver a better client experience.
